headline: Coca-Cola raises full-year earnings outlook following $13.4 billion quarterly revenue
summary: The Coca-Cola Company increased its full-year profit and cash-flow forecasts after generating $13.4 billion in quarterly revenue. Strong sales growth and market share gains in Nigeria supported global performance.
why: Coca-Cola is a global consumer staples giant whose revenue trends reflect global consumer demand and inflation pass-through.

impacts.name: The Coca-Cola Company
impacts.why: Upgraded profit and cash flow forecasts boosted investor expectations.

why_moved: Upgraded full-year financial forecasts outweighed macroeconomic challenges in emerging markets.
